grounding.note: Tapered open cup or glass resting on the surface
Liquid indicated filling the lower half of the glass
Horizontal support surface beneath the glass

questions.prompt: The simulation engine is restricted to rigid-body mechanics and cannot simulate actual continuous fluid dynamics (CFD), surface tension, or Navier-Stokes flow. How would you like to handle the water?
options: Approximate the water using dynamic rigid spheres that spill when tilted
Model the water as a single rigid block proxy
Cancel simulation because actual fluid flow is strictly required

warnings: Continuous fluid flow and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are outside the capabilities of this rigid-body physics engine.
message: The system only supports rigid body mechanics; continuous fluids and CFD cannot be simulated. Please clarify whether a rigid-particle proxy is acceptable or if actual fluid dynamics are strictly required.
